name: Landing Eater

Traits.name: Still Stair
Traits.text: While the landing eater remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an ordinary section of the staircase it inhabits.
Traits.expresses: a hunger shaped as a climbable staircase
Traits.expressedQuote: indistinguishable from an ordinary section of the staircase it inhabits

Traits.name: Folding Steps
Traits.text: The landing eater ignores Difficult Terrain, and Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The landing eater makes three Chitin Step attacks. It can replace one attack with a Swallowing Landing attack.

Actions.name: Chitin Step
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Acid damage.

Actions.name: Swallowing Landing (Beast or Hybrid Form Only)
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 15. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Shape-Shift
Bonus Actions.text: The landing eater shape-shifts into a Large beast-humanoid hybrid or a Medium beast, or it returns to its true humanoid form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

Bonus Actions.name: Fleet Agility
Bonus Actions.text: The landing eater takes the Dash or Disengage action.

lore: Born when an arcane stair-lift folded into a feral hunger, it feeds on every climber, wanting only to find ever larger bodies to become stairs inside.

generation.userConcept: a hunger that wears the shape of a staircase

clauses.text: wears the shape of a staircase

monsterDescription: a hunger that wears the shape of a staircase
